$comment: How Hullo's route is drawn where the GTFS alone doesn't say; every route in the feed is drawn by default, and the format is in config/feeds/translink/routes.json. The GTFS has one route per direction (NAN-VAN 'Nanaimo to Vancouver', VAN-NAN 'Vancouver to Nanaimo', both route_type 4), drawn as one route. No route_color in the GTFS: #ff3503 is the theme colour of hullo.com (checked 2026-11-02).

headsigns.$comment: The GTFS's trip_headsign is the destination's stop_id.

kinematics.$comment: guess: fast catamarans; the 75-minute timetabled crossing of ~65 km averages ~28 kn with the slow harbour legs, so ~32 kn in open water. Length and beam guessed. config/feeds/hullo/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #2
